scope: Complete vp-vnp/ subtree, plus the repository comparator script and Lean CI workflow. External toolchains, dependencies and build products are not embedded.

local_replay.scope: Review-run verification, distinguished by pass and execution site. The complete native project rebuild used pinned prebuilt external libraries. The separate Linux job built the project and ran the publisher Comparator and nanoda.

crossing.scope: Independent finite determinant, coefficient, rank and metric checks. General crossing declarations were imported as part of the earlier C.1 build.

spectral_selection.scope: Fresh queries on 11 publisher declarations using the 24 source- and object-checked pass-10 modules. Four new elementary declarations checked.

piece_decomposition.scope: Fresh separate builds of Nc.Cut.Groups (2 modules) and Paper.Heavy (4 modules), with queries on five publisher declarations. The full Paper.Pieces and Paper.Cuts modules remain open.

field_transfer.scope: Fresh 12-module Paper.Transfer build and readback of the common ring, finite specialization and M.1. The prime-field obstruction was checked in the same import. M.3/M.4 were inspected in source only.

law_move_and_load.scope: Two original modules in the Nc.Tow.Load closure, with stage load readback and independent compensated induction. Three publisher declarations queried in a separate isolated law harness. Full Paper.Tree and G.2 remain outside this replay.

hc_projection.scope: Fresh 13-module Paper.HcGrid closure. Eight publisher declarations read back, including M.2 and affine substitution. Independent finite graph/cycle enumeration.

flat_rate.scope: Five unchanged publisher arithmetic declarations checked in isolation and an independent general induction. Mathematical audit and exact finite controls. Full E.7–E.11 modules were not rebuilt for this track.

crossing_counts_and_minors.scope: Fresh 10-module Paper.Identity closure. Eight publisher declarations queried, including B.1 and B.2. The explicit normalization and signed-minor formula for the printed convention are independent mathematical derivations.

hub_routing.scope: Local-map derivation and exact enumeration of 116 placements and 600 entries. The 12E Paper.Alternative closure includes Paper.Prices.

field_alternative.scope: Fresh 54-module Paper.Alternative closure, including complete original modules for C.1, C.3, C.4's toolkit and D.2. Formal readbacks cover the shared price and the field alternative. The arbitrary-field caller M.3 and the full separation are separate targets.

gate_reuse.scope: Two fresh publisher modules and an isolated unchanged E.4 excerpt. The separate joint build also covers the full Paper.Flat module.

uniform_gain.scope: Two independent real-valued budget lemmas against pinned mathlib and finite cut/rounding controls. Publisher G.2 is covered by the separate joint build.

permanent_grid.scope: 12 original modules through Paper.Grids; ten types and seven axiom sets. E.3 is additionally covered by the joint Paper.Flat module build.

hc_membership.scope: 13 original modules through Nc.Hc.Vnp with five types, five axiom queries and a separately instantiated membership proof term. The strict-inclusion caller in Paper.Fields was inspected in source.

combined_branches.scope: Fresh union of Paper.Flat (115) and Paper.Laws (113), 110 shared and 118 unique project modules. Ten types and ten axiom queries. The complete exact separation, remaining downstream branches and Comparator are separate targets.

local_replay.comparator_replay_location: Linux GitHub Actions runner in the review repository; separate from the native macOS rebuild.

full_local_build.scope: All 323 modules in four default-target closures and the original reporting script compiled afresh, on the pinned external library cache. Five isolated pairs of challenge and solution signatures agree. 22 solution-side axiom records. All public declarations include the exact and approximate endpoints.

review_owned_linux_comparator.scope: Separate Linux execution in the review repository using the publisher checker, configured five targets, and compulsory nanoda proof replay.

flat_circuit_strict_bound.scope: Independent /12 implication checked against the exact fresh Paper.Rate object in the local full build; outside the public five-theorem Comparator configuration.
